facts.fact: The warden's shutters are held on the wedding night only by an iron latch; the long teak bar hangs unused on its hooks.

The guild's pass-village watcher walks the hill edge each dawn reading fresh scent-marks; a first night with none reads as refusal and is reported to Chathu. This is why Neela must turn on the wedding night.
Neela deliberately presses the third slat to test whether the creak wakes Devan. She treats a sleeper's unchanged breathing as proof of nothing.

Captain Muthu sleeps in the lower barracks and wakes Devan for the dawn watch twice a week. The wedding bangle was made from a measure the council sent. There is a draught by the stair outside the warden's chamber.
